svg.title: A blocking tray must move first
svg.desc: Root tray R at P17 must reach bay B21. Its exits via P15 and P20 are occupied, so AGV-1 first relocates blocker K from P15 to P19, then fetches R and carries it to B21; each move is previewed as a numbered arrow and played in the next step.
svg.metadata: ["Start: root tray R at P17 must reach bay B21. P17 connects only to P15, P20 and charger C16; K holds P15, T20 holds P20 and C16 is a dead end, so R is boxed in. AGV-1 waits at W13.", "\u2460 AgvMove AGV-1 (dashed arrow): the first move of the plan is an unloaded drive W13 -> P15, under the blocker K.", "AGV-1 drives W13 -> P15 and lifts K. Next, \u2461 TrayMove K: carry K to the free stall P19, off R's way out.", "AGV-1 carries K from P15 to P19 (\u2461); P15 is now free. Next, \u2462 AgvMove AGV-1: lower K and drive back unloaded P19 -> P15 -> P17. \u2462 must wait for \u2461, because P15 was occupied until then.", "AGV-1 lowers K at P19, drives P19 -> P15 -> P17 and lifts R. Next, \u2463 TrayMove R: carry R out via P15, W13, W18, W22 and W41 into bay B21.", "AGV-1 carries R along \u2463 into bay B21. The BayTransition at B21 depends on \u2463.", "AGV-1 lowers R in B21 and the bay switches to retrieve, handing the car to the customer. The whole plan at once: the four numbered moves in the order the planner must respect, from the starting positions (dashed) to where the plan leaves every tray."]
